title: ECS Fargate Service Behind an ALB
scenario: Run a small Fargate service and register it with an ALB target group on port 80.
constraints: Create cluster, task definition and service.
Task uses Fargate/awsvpc and small CPU/memory.
Service registers with the target group.

focus.title: Complete the aws_ecs_service resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_ecs_service.

hints.why: Container services need a cluster, task definition and service wiring. Codifying them makes image and capacity changes reviewable.
hints.what: Complete the marked TODO in `main.tf`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_ecs_service. Use the visible constraints as your checklist before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use ECS when you want managed container orchestration without adopting Kubernetes.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work inside the single TODO region. Change one requirement at a time: add the named block, argument or reference, then run the tests. When a check fails, match its wording to the constraints and fix only the block it names.
